title: Nexus StaleFindingsResponse
description: Response for `GET /v1/daemon/findings/stale` (V1.39 P4 T3): open findings for the active creator that aged past the stale threshold (default 96h; the threshold resolution stays at the adapter because the watcher schedule is daemon runtime state). v2 corrects the schema to the live wire envelope (`stale_count` / `threshold_seconds` / `now_epoch` / `findings`); the previous `open_count`/`items` shape was never emitted by the handler.

stale_count.description: Number of open findings older than `threshold_seconds`.

now_epoch.description: Server-side epoch second used as `now` for the cutoff calculation.

findings.description: Per-finding summaries, oldest first; the CLI banner surfaces the most-aged item.

created_at.description: Epoch second the finding was created.
